THE PROBLEM

Patient safety should not depend on fragmented workflows.

Safety teams spend much of their time moving information between systems instead of assessing it.

  • Scattered sources

    Safety information sits in emails, documents, literature, spreadsheets and systems that do not talk to each other.

  • Manual intake

    Case intake, transcription, duplicate checks and medical coding are still largely done by hand.

  • Repeated checks

    The same completeness and quality checks are run again at every hand-off.

  • Disconnected records

    Clinical, pharmacy, regulatory and distribution records live apart, so every link is rebuilt by hand.

  • Timelines rebuilt from scratch

    Working out which product and batch reached which patient, and when, means slow document-by-document reconstruction.

  • Limited visibility

    When a product-quality concern is reported in one place, it is hard to tell whether it needs investigating elsewhere.

Vyom connects the evidence once, keeps every link traceable, and leaves the decisions to qualified people.

THE RECORD KEEPS

The original file, its arrival time and its source reference.

WHY AI-NATIVE

Built around the safety workflow, not bolted onto it.

AI added to an old workflow speeds up one step and leaves the gaps between steps. Vyom is designed so that every step shares the same records, checks and history.

  1. 01Context-aware processingEach step works on the connected records, not an isolated form.
  2. 02Traceable outputsEvery generated field, summary or draft links back to the source evidence.
  3. 03Continuous validationChecks run throughout the workflow, not only at the end.
  4. 04Human review and overridePeople can correct or override any output, and the correction is kept.
  5. 05Explainable findingsFindings show their evidence and uncertainty, with a versioned audit history.
  6. 06Configurable controlsThresholds, approvals and access are set per organisation for regulated work.
ENTERPRISE TRUST

Designed for accountable safety operations.

Controls are part of the design, so each organisation can validate Vyom against its own requirements.

  • Evidence-linked outputsEvery output points to the records and passages behind it.
  • Role-based permissionsAccess is granted by role and need, for each organisation.
  • Traceable changesWho changed what, when and why, with full review history.
  • Configurable workflowsValidation rules and approval steps are set by your quality team.
  • Data protectionIsolated, encrypted data for each customer, with controlled access.
  • Validation supportBuilt to support customer validation and applicable regulatory requirements.
